messages.ok: Good elbow bend at the bottom of the push-up.
messages.low: Elbows are bent very tightly. Lower until your chest is just above the floor without collapsing.
messages.high: Lower deeper until your elbows bend closer to 90 degrees (take the photo at the bottom of the rep).

messages.ok: Body stays in a straight line from shoulders to ankles.
messages.low: Hips are sagging or piking. Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep a straight line.
messages.high: Hips are slightly out of line. Keep a straight line from shoulders to ankles.

messages.ok: Good knee depth at the bottom of the squat.
messages.low: Very deep knee bend. Keep your heels flat and stay in control at the bottom.
messages.high: Squat slightly deeper if your mobility allows (take the photo at the lowest point).

messages.ok: Body forms a straight line from shoulders to ankles.
messages.low: Hips are sagging or raised too high. Brace your stomach and align shoulders, hips, and ankles.
messages.high: Hips are out of alignment. Keep your body in one straight line.
